title: Command
description: An interaction-layer command from the operator to the cockpit. Two shapes: a free node-scoped steering message, or a slash command. Commands NEVER write the fcd store or forge journal events directly; they request transitions that the fcd machine either performs or refuses (fail-closed). A command that would violate an fcd invariant is rejected, not silently applied.

kind.description: 'steer' = free natural-language steering scoped to a node. 'slash' = a structured slash command.

target.description: The node this command is scoped to. Steering and questions attach here and block ONLY this node.

issued_at.description: Logical time the command was issued.

actor.description: Operator identity. Recorded, never used to widen an allow set.

text.description: Free steering text scoped to target.

name.description: Slash command name without the leading '/'.

args.description: Command-specific arguments. See docs/INTERACTION_LAYER.md for the per-command contract.

node_id.description: An item or stage node id in the current AtlasSnapshot.

line.description: Optional compiled-contract line index. An unresolved question on this line blocks ONLY the affected line, not sibling lines.
